description: Observed RL Stealer samples use `Information.txt` with equals-sign section dividers and single-space-indented key/value lines. Public analysis identifies it as a 44CALIBER variant and notes a StringsCrypt module also seen in StormKitty; neither relationship is treated as an alias. This sample shape is not an active fingerprint.
name: RL Stealer
targets: Browser saved credentials, cookies, autofill, history
Crypto wallet extensions and desktop clients
Discord, Telegram, Steam, Minecraft session data
